title: 第14章 反楚联盟
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

刘邦还定三秦后究竟靠什么手段组织的“反楚联盟”56万大军的？靠演戏。那么究竟56万大军是怎么被项羽3万精兵干掉的？靠实力。

前205年3月，刘邦军抵达洛阳附近的新城，令他稍感意外的是他前脚刚到，便有人拦着他告状。和一般的平民告状不同，这个告状人的身份很特别——三老董公。当时设县、乡、邑三级，乡级长官为三老。他的请求很简单，项羽杀了义帝，求汉王为义帝讨回公道。

义帝被项羽杀害之事刘邦早有耳闻，如今更加确定了，刘邦立刻意识到自己可以拿此事大做文章。于是，当着所有人的面，刘邦做出了一个惊人的举动：哭、痛哭、使劲哭、嚎啕大哭，他哭得就像一个小孩子，动作很滑稽，样子很搞笑。

不得不说刘邦真是个好演员，在没有经过任何彩排的情况下，台词说的非常溜，整场戏拿捏得恰到好处，感染力极强，成功带动了大家的情绪。

表演完苦功后，刘邦立马上演嘴上功夫，当众宣布：“我汉王刘邦誓与各路诸侯王一起铲除诛杀义帝的罪人项羽，以报血仇！”

《史记·高祖本纪》记载：【汉王闻之，袒而大哭。遂为义帝发丧，临三日。】

演说完毕后，刘邦马上派人设立祭坛，为义帝举行了隆重的发丧仪式。祭坛上，刘邦脱掉上衣，裸露双臂，一边放声大哭，一边义愤填膺，对天盟誓：“【天下共立义帝，北面事之。今项羽放杀义帝于江南，大逆无道。寡人亲为发丧，诸侯皆缟素。悉发关内兵，收三河士，南浮江汉以下，愿从诸侯王击楚之杀义帝者。】”这就是刘邦的《发使告诸侯书》。

至此，他正式当着全天下的面宣布讨伐项羽，同时还听从张良的建议，宣布废除秦社稷，立下汉社稷。这两点为刘邦出兵提供了冠冕堂皇的理由和借口。

此时，楚汉争霸支线的第一场战役三秦战役已基本结束，马上要进入的是主线四大战役的第一战——彭城之战。

为了争取更多诸侯的支持，刘邦打算拉拢陈馀向他问计。陈馀不仅足智多谋，且与项羽仇深似海，如果此时能将他收为己用，一来可以解除刘邦在进军途中的后顾之忧，二来可以大大增强刘邦军的实力。可以说是一举多得。

面对刘邦抛来的橄榄枝，陈馀态度很明确：“我也想与汉王您达成联军协议，但我也有不得已的苦衷啊。如今张耳在您麾下，我又与他势不两立，咱们合作的时机不成熟。”

刘邦问他要怎么办。陈馀只回答了一个字：“杀！”

面对陈馀提出的条件，刘邦怔住了，一来他和张耳有师生情谊，二来张耳不远千里投奔自己，有情有义，如果杀了他，那会寒了天下人的心。

杀张耳可以得到陈馀，不杀张耳就得不到陈馀，这看似是一个鱼和熊掌不可兼得的问题，但刘邦很快找到了两全其美的办法，他一边信誓旦旦答应了陈馀的要求，另一边用心良苦地为张耳找了个替死鬼。

看着血肉模糊的人头，陈馀笑了，那是怎样一种消仇解恨的舒心啊！随后他也履行了自己的义务——出兵助刘邦。

Liu Bang also decided that by what means did the Three Qin Dynasties organize the 560,000-strong "Anti-Chu Alliance"?By acting.So how did Xiang Yu's 30,000 elite troops defeat an army of 560,000?Rely on strength.

In March 205 BC, Liu Bangjun arrived in Xincheng near Luoyang. What surprised him was that as soon as he arrived, someone stopped him to complain.Different from ordinary civilian complaints, the identity of this complainant is very special-San Lao Dong Gong.At that time, there were three levels: county, township and city, and the township-level chiefs were the three elders.His request was simple. Xiang Yu killed Emperor Yi and asked the King of Han to seek justice for Emperor Yi.

Liu Bang had already heard about the murder of Emperor Yi by Xiang Yu, and now it was even more certain. Liu Bang immediately realized that he could make a big fuss out of this matter.So, in front of everyone, Liu Bang made an astonishing move: he cried, cried hard, cried hard, and howled. He cried like a child, his movements were funny, and his appearance was funny.

I have to say that Liu Bang is really a good actor. Without any rehearsal, he spoke his lines very smoothly. The whole scene was just right, extremely contagious, and successfully aroused everyone's emotions.

After performing the hard work, Liu Bang immediately put on some lip service and announced in public: "I, Liu Bang, the King of Han, swear to work with all the princes and kings to eradicate Xiang Yu, the sinner who killed Emperor Yi, in order to avenge blood!"

"Historical Records: The Benji of Emperor Gaozu" records: [When the king of Han heard this, he opened his mouth and burst into tears.Then the mourning for the Righteous Emperor was held for three days.】

After the speech, Liu Bang immediately sent someone to set up an altar and held a grand funeral ceremony for Emperor Yi.On the altar, Liu Bang took off his shirt, exposed his arms, cried loudly, filled with righteous indignation, and swore to the heavenly alliance: "[The world will establish the Righteous Emperor together, and we will do it from the north. Now Xiang Yu lets the Righteous Emperor be killed in the south of the Yangtze River, which is a great rebellion."Dao.I am personally mourning, and all the princes are in mourning.I have sent troops to the pass, gathered soldiers from Sanhe, and floated south to Jianghan.I am willing to attack Chu from the princes and kill the Yi Emperor." This is Liu Bang's "Message to the Princes".

At this point, he officially announced the crusade against Xiang Yu in front of the whole world. At the same time, he also followed Zhang Liang's suggestion and announced the abolition of the Qin State and the establishment of the Han State.These two points provided Liu Bang with high-sounding reasons and excuses for sending troops.

At this time, the Sanqin Battle, the first battle in the branch line of the Chu-Han War for Hegemony, has basically ended, and what is about to enter is the first battle of the four major battles in the main line - the Battle of Pengcheng.

In order to win the support of more princes, Liu Bang planned to win over Chen Yu to ask him for advice.Chen Yu is not only resourceful, but also has a deep hatred for Xiang Yu. If he can be used as his own at this time, it will relieve Liu Bang's worries during the march and greatly enhance the strength of Liu Bang's army.It can be said that it accomplishes multiple things with one stone.

Facing the olive branch extended by Liu Bang, Chen Yu's attitude was very clear: "I also want to reach an alliance agreement with you, the King of Han, but I also have difficulties. Now that Zhang Er is under your command, and I am at odds with him, the time for our cooperation is not ripe."

Liu Bang asked him what to do.Chen Yu only answered with one word: "Kill!"

Faced with the conditions proposed by Chen Yu, Liu Bang was stunned. Firstly, he and Zhang Er had a teacher-student friendship, and secondly, Zhang Er had traveled thousands of miles to join him. He was affectionate and righteous. If he were to be killed, it would chill the hearts of the people in the world.

If you kill Zhang Er, you can get Chen Yu, but if you don't kill Zhang Er, you can't get Chen Yu. This seems to be a problem that you can't have your cake and eat it too, but Liu Bang quickly found a way to get the best of both worlds. On the one hand, he vowed to agree to Chen Yu's request, and on the other hand, he found a scapegoat for Zhang Er with good intentions.

Looking at the bloody head, Chen Yu smiled. What a kind of relief it was to relieve hatred and resolve hatred!Then he also fulfilled his obligation-sending troops to help Liu Bang.
